# MultiDropdown — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A multi-select dropdown that renders a list of options as toggleable rows and shows the selection as removable tags in the trigger — with support for fully customisable option rows via per-option or global render functions.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.
